entities.name: General Relativity
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: Einstein's theory (1915) that gravity is not a force but the curvature of spacetime caused by mass and energy. Confirmed by the 1919 solar eclipse, gravitational waves (2015), and black hole imaging (2019), general relativity reshaped our understanding of the universe and underpins GPS technology, cosmology, and astrophysics.
